exercises.instructions: Transform the following sentences between 'too … to' and 'so … that'.

questions.question: The theory was too complicated for me to understand. Transform to 'so … that'.
options: so complicated that I could not understand it
so complicated that I can understand it
too complicated that I could not understand it
questions.answer: so complicated that I could not understand it
questions.explanation: Transform 'too … for … to' → 'so … that … could not'. 'Can' is wrong tense. 'Too … that' mixes structures. 'So … that' ကို 'too … to' ပြောင်းဖို့ သုံးပါ။
